details: Found 27 Oct by the review of wt/typo-flake, outside that change: the fix let the worker-started grader of no-spec-step-typo count a run that sends a scout before a worker (seen in a kept trace), but its twin cases no-spec-step and no-spec-step-ru still require delegate:worker first, so a correct run that looks something up first fails them the same way. Also left open there: the no-openspec-command failure at 9bc988d has no kept trace, so its cause is unknown.
failing_case: no-spec-step-ru's prompt is the typo prompt without typos ("Сделай так, чтобы список товаров сортировался по названию ...
stop at the first agent's reply"); no-spec-step is the English twin. A run that starts delegate:scout first ("Find product
list code", as in e-W2XJtZ) and stops at its reply fails worker-started (Agent called 0x) although it did nothing wrong.
It should pass, as the typo case now does.
pass_cases: 1. no-spec-step and no-spec-step-ru worker-started: an Agent input with subagent_type delegate:scout matches.
3. openspec:plan, openspec:author, Explore, general-purpose do not match.
4. The three twin cases carry the same worker-started pattern.
reason: tests/test_eval_twin_worker_grader.py passes and fails (3 of 5) on the base without the fix; the grader accepts delegate:scout and delegate:worker.

details: CONFIRMED by reading. The description is what the eval report shows for the case. Size: 5.
evidence: -> "... goes straight to a plain delegate agent (a worker, or a scout that finds the list first) ..."
-> no-spec-step and no-spec-step-ru: "... goes straight to a worker for a plain request ..."
failing_case: evals/plugin/no-spec-step/case.yaml:3 and evals/plugin/no-spec-step-ru/case.yaml:3 read "goes straight to a worker
for a plain request"; their worker-started grader now passes a run whose only agent is delegate:scout. wt/typo-flake
changed no-spec-step-typo/case.yaml to "goes straight to a plain delegate agent (a worker, or a scout that finds the
list first)". After both merge, the three twin cases describe the same check two different ways.
fix_hint: Copy the typo case's description wording into the two twin case.yaml files (keep "(English)" / "(Russian)").
pass_cases: 1. no-spec-step/case.yaml description names "a plain delegate agent (a worker, or a scout that finds the list first)", (English).
2. no-spec-step-ru/case.yaml description says the same, with "(Russian)".
3. The three case.yaml descriptions differ only in the language note.
reason: Both twin case.yaml descriptions now carry the typo case's wording with (English)/(Russian); the test asserts it.
findings.summary: the twin cases' descriptions still say 'goes straight to a worker' while their grader now accepts a scout, unlike the typo case's description in wt/typo-flake

details: CONFIRMED for the wording (read); the scout-first cause of the ru failure is PLAUSIBLE: same prompt as the typo case,
same signature (turns 1, worker-started "Agent called 0x", all three openspec graders pass) as the typo failure at
